protocol.timing_release_note: budget_decision explicitly confirmed timing.json published and all timing/behavior jobs ended before this run
protocol.source_entrypoint: direct original source agent; independent research side
protocol.interpretation: Only four complete external diagnostic games per model on two new maps and both seats. Not a registered exam, promotion gate, population strength estimate, or seed-paired improvement estimate. Original _SEED=None and time-budget search preclude identical stochastic reruns.
protocol.terminal_scoring: eval_v53._extinct after each transition. Extinct score=t-episodeSteps-1; survivor of extinction gets pre-transition cash; normal episode limit gets final cash. Errors stop without fallback and invalidate outcome.
protocol.exception_mode: CARBON_DEBUG=1 surfaces outer agent/search exceptions. Actual search stats and network identity are also recorded; original internal network build fallbacks remain unchanged.

prior_timing_estimate.scope: Extrapolation from prior 60-step games, not a resource guarantee or an independent fresh timed benchmark.
